mapper.select: SELECT id, code, name, description, sort_order, created_at, updated_at FROM sys_perm_group WHERE code = #{code} LIMIT 1

SELECT g.id, g.code, g.name, g.description, g.sort_order, g.created_at, g.updated_at FROM sys_perm_group g INNER JOIN sys_role_perm_group rpg ON rpg.group_id = g.id WHERE rpg.role_id = #{roleId} ORDER BY g.sort_order ASC, g.code ASC
